instruction.text: Read the story and answer the questions.

atoms.text: Just a moment before, the little ant had been eating a delicious berry at the side of the river, when the wind suddenly picked him up and carried him into the water. Now, he was desperately swimming for his life.
“Help me!” he cried. But he knew none of his ant friends could help. They could not swim either. “Who else will help me!?” he thought desperately.
atoms.sound: ssml:<voice voice='m4_2025'> “Help me!” </voice> he cried. But he knew none of his ant friends could help. They could not swim either. <voice voice='m4_2025'>“Who else will help me!?”</voice> he thought desperately.

atoms.a: Why did the ant think no one would help him?
b: No one saw him on the leaf.

atoms.text: All the while, a dove sat in a tree watching the events unfold, still undecided. The dove thought to herself, “The life of an ant is so small, and doves do not normally help ants.” But the dove felt sorry for the ant and decided she could do something small.
atoms.sound: ssml:All the while, a dove sat in a tree watching the events unfold, still undecided. The dove thought to herself, <voice voice='f2'>“The life of an ant is so small, and doves do not normally help ants.”</voice> But the dove felt sorry for the ant and decided she could do something small.

atoms.text: She picked up a blade of grass with her beak and dropped it next to the ant struggling in the water. The ant clung to the blade, and it eventually brought him to shore. He was saved.
atoms.sound: ssml:She picked up a blade of grass with her beak and dropped it next to the ant struggling in the water. The ant clung to the blade, and it eventually brought him to shore. He was saved.

atoms.a: How did the dove help the ant?
b: ++The dove brought the ant a blade of grass.
The dove cheered the ant on.

atoms.text: The same day, the ant saw the dove trapped by a human! “I have to help her!” said the ant. He bravely approached the human, climbed on its leg and bit as hard as he could, just above the sock. The human yelped and, in their surprise, dropped the dove. She was free.

atoms.a: How did the ant help the dove?
b: The ant did not help the dove.

atoms.a: What is the lesson of this fable?
b: ++The smallest of kindnesses is never wasted.
